title: Variational Principles for Dilute Spin Systems
exact_target: For dilute ferromagnets and sparse spin glasses, does the GREM-associated trial order parameter give the correct variational formula for the pressure? Does the numerator have a direct differential-equation formulation analogous to the Parisi equation? For the dilute ferromagnet, can one prove $\log Z_{N+M}\leq\log Z_N+\log Z_M$ directly? How should the pressure variational principle be formulated to exhibit appropriate trial order parameters, an entropy-minus-internal-energy interpretation, or a Legendre structure?
